def: a spread (as if tramped flat) of loose materials for a couch, i.e. (by implication) a bough of a tree so employed

occurrences.text: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
